text: And into the north, through the mountain passes, came new arrivals once again.
In 1206, Gori's general, Kutubuddin Aibak, became the first ruler of the Delhi Sultanate.
He began the tallest brick minaret in the world, the Kutub Minar.
Around the same time, according to later chronicles, raiders led by Bakhtiar Khalji attacked Nalanda,
and the great university was ruined. For the next three hundred years, five different dynasties
would rule from Delhi. One sultan, Alauddin Khalji, beat back several Mongol invasions.
Unlike China, Persia, and Russia, India was never conquered by the Mongols. He also tried
something very modern, price controls. He fixed the price of grain, horses, cloth, even slaves.
in the markets of Delhi, and punished cheating shopkeepers harshly. In 1526, a young prince
from Central Asia rode down from Kabul. He had lost his homeland more than once. He was looking
for a new one. His great-great-great-grandfather was Timur, and on his mother's side, he was
